messages.content: Rani has ten more crabs than Monic, who has 4 fewer crabs than Bo. If Bo has 40 crabs and 30 shrimp, calculate the total number of crabs the three have together.

content.text:
Monic: 40 - 6 = 34 crabs
Rani: 34 + 10 = 44 crabs
Total crabs: 40 + 34 + 44 = **118 crabs**
